title: The Saints Emmanuel'S Portion Are
description: The Saints Emmanuel'S Portion Are in Tonic Solfa to OLD HUNDREDTH, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: John Newton wrote these words. They were printed in Olney Hymns (London, 1779), Book III, hymn 99, “Deut 32:9,10”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to OLD HUNDREDTH; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: The saints Em-ma-nuel'S por-tion are, Re-deemed by price, re-claimed by pow'r; His spe-cial choice, and ten-der care, Owns them and guards them ev-ery hour.

lines: Redeemed by price, reclaimed by pow'r;
His special choice, and tender care,
Owns them and guards them every hour.
He finds them in a barren land
Beset with sins, and fears, and woes;
He leads and guides them by his hand,
And bears them safe from all their foes.

source: John Newton and William Cowper, Olney Hymns (1779)
licence: Public domain: John Newton died in 1807.
credits: Words by John Newton (1725–1807), public domain, as printed in Olney Hymns (1779); set to OLD HUNDREDTH by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
